rationale: The Latin anchors *tendere*, *extendere*, and *expandere* — together with the biblical quotation *extende manum tuam* ("stretch out your hand") and *arcum suum tetendit* ("he stretched/bent his bow") — all point to a concrete, physical sense of stretching or extending something in space. This matches expand.v.01 ("extend in one or more directions"), which covers the literal spatial spreading/stretching sense, as opposed to the growth/volume sense of expand.v.02 or the metaphorical senses.
